title: Rules-series horror frame for HyperFrames
description: Locked series frame for rules-story horror: case-file HUD (identity label, file number, rule progress, timecode), sentence captions from measured words, RULE N card, exhibit card, red X/check/YOU marks, rule boxes, glitch and grain/bloom/vignette finish. Landscape and vertical.
usage: Run identity-continue for the project, write series.json, then npm run video -- series-kit --job jobs/<slug> (installs this bundle and writes assets/series/series-data.js). Load kit.js and series-data.js in each scene template, add cards with RulesSeries.ruleCard/exhibit/redX/sequence and call RulesSeries.mount last. See README.md.
